MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The short Ethernet cables fit my recent Ethernet adapter and cable purchases: they could connect nearby devices while reducing clutter.",
    "The powered USB hub fits my keyboard, adapters, and other accessories because it would help me connect and manage them together."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices do not help with the practical computer, networking, and desk setup tasks reflected in my recent choices.",
    "The Fire TV Stick adds another entertainment device when I already have a Raspberry Pi project, and its Ethernet adapter has no clear use for me without a Fire TV.",
    "The large SSD and drive dock relate to computers, but I have no current storage upgrade or bare drive to connect. The HDMI cable is useful in principle, but my existing cable already covers that need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been treated as interest in smart speakers, displays, and streaming devices generally.",
    "Buying cables and adapters seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest more of them without considering which connections I already have covered."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My cable management kit, cable ties, and under-desk headphone holder suggest that organizing my existing setup matters to me.",
    "Compatibility and an immediate purpose matter: short Ethernet cables and a USB hub complement what I use, while a Fire TV adapter requires a device I have not shown a need for.",
    "Frequent accessory purchases do not mean I currently need a major hardware upgrade or another device with an overlapping purpose."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my setup needs but stretched that interest into electronics that do not solve a current task."
}
